# Cookist

> > Cookist is a culinary platform delivering simple, fast, and fun recipes daily, from classic desserts to international main dishes.

Cookist features comprehensive recipe collections, cooking guides, and kitchen tips for home cooks of all skill levels. The site includes content from renowned chefs like Paul Hollywood and Nigella Lawson, plus practical how-to guides covering food preparation, appliances like air fryers, and time-saving techniques.

## Key Topics

- Recipes
- Desserts
- Main Dishes
- Baking
- Quick & Easy Cooking
- Kitchen Tips
- Food Preparation
- Air Fryer
- Appetizers
- Cooking Techniques
- Nutrition
- Paul Hollywood
- Nigella Lawson
- Ruth Wakefield
- Toll House Inn

## Recipe Collections

- [Recipes](https://www.cookist.com/recipes/): Main recipe collection hub featuring desserts, mains, and appetizers
- [Main dishes](https://www.cookist.com/recipes/main-dish-recipes/): International main dish recipe collection with beef, chicken, and pasta
- [Desserts](https://www.cookist.com/recipes/desserts/): Dessert recipe collection with cakes, cookies, and gluten-free options
- [Quick & Easy](https://www.cookist.com/recipes/real-wow-factor/quick-easy/): Quick and easy recipe collection for fast, simple meals

## Getting Started

- [Cookist](https://www.cookist.com/): Homepage featuring simple, fast, and fun recipes daily
- [How-to](https://www.cookist.com/how-to/): Cooking guides covering food storage, appliances, and kitchen techniques

## Featured Recipes

- [The Best Chocolate Chip Cookie Recipe Ever (Crunchy Outside, Chewy Inside)](https://www.cookist.com/chocolate-chip-cookies/p9/): Ruth Wakefield's classic chocolate chip cookie recipe from Toll House Inn

- [Kitchen Hacks](https://video.cookist.com/gallery/aj/594e72bde4b0fb392ca03e19?photo=594e72bfe4b0fb392ca041cc&theater=true&noshow=true): Kitchen hacks and tips for time-saving cooking with household objects
- [Anti-Anxiety Foods](https://video.cookist.com/gallery/an/5a0c09d7e4b001060ea02044?photo=5a0c09d7e4b001060ea020c3&theater=true): Article on anti-anxiety foods and stress-relief through nutrition
